title: Understanding Blue Account overdraft fees
summary: Explains Blue Account overdraft fees: the overdraft fee per item is $0.00, and a maximum of 3 overdraft fees can be charged per day. Because the fee is $0.00, no overdraft fee amount is deducted when your balance goes negative.
faqs: What is the Blue Account overdraft fee per item?
How many overdraft fees can be charged in one day?
Will I be charged an overdraft fee if my Blue Account balance goes negative?
Does a $0.00 overdraft fee still affect my available balance?
